name: Bhuvan
description: ISRO's national geo-platform for satellite imagery, thematic maps and geospatial services.

name: Bhoonidhi
description: ISRO's portal for ordering and downloading satellite data products (Resourcesat, Cartosat, etc.).

name: Bhuvan NICES
description: National Information System for Climate and Environment Studies — long-term EO analytics.

name: MOSDAC
description: Meteorological & Oceanographic Satellite Data Centre — weather, ocean and atmosphere data.

name: VEDAS
description: Visualisation of Earth observation Data and Archival System — decision-support analytics.

name: NDEM
description: National Database for Emergency Management — disaster maps and exposure data.

name: India-WRIS
description: Water Resources Information System — basins, dams, groundwater, water quality.

name: Central Water Commission
description: Hydrological observations, flood forecasts and water-resource data.

name: India Meteorological Department
description: Weather forecasts, climate monitoring and historical meteorological data.

name: Forest Survey of India
description: Biennial State of Forest Report, forest cover and tree cover data.

name: Bhukosh (GSI)
description: Geological Survey of India's geological, geophysical and geochemical maps.

name: Census of India
description: Population census tables, village/town directories and boundary data.

name: Open Government Data (data.gov.in)
description: India's open data portal — thousands of central & state datasets with APIs.

name: Survey of India
description: National mapping agency — topographic maps, geodetic control, boundaries.

name: SoI Open Series Maps (Nakshe)
description: Free download of Open Series topographic maps of India.

name: NATMO
description: National Atlas & Thematic Mapping Organisation — thematic and atlas maps.

name: Krishi (ICAR Data Centre)
description: ICAR's knowledge management and data repository for agricultural research.

name: INCOIS
description: Ocean state forecasts, potential fishing zones, tsunami and storm-surge warnings.

name: KSRSAC (Karnataka Geoportal)
description: Karnataka State Remote Sensing Applications Centre — state-level geospatial data.

name: OpenStreetMap (Geofabrik India)
description: OpenStreetMap extracts for India — roads, buildings, land use and POIs (ODbL).

name: DataMeet Maps
description: Community-curated open boundaries and maps of India (districts, states, ACs/PCs).

name: Microsoft Building Footprints
description: AI-generated building footprints for most countries, freely downloadable.

name: Google Open Buildings
description: AI-derived building footprint dataset covering South Asia, Africa and more.

name: Natural Earth
description: Public-domain vector & raster basemap data at 1:10m, 1:50m and 1:110m.

name: NASA SEDAC
description: Socio-economic and environmental datasets: population, gridded demography, hazards.

name: USGS EarthExplorer
description: Global Landsat and other satellite imagery search and download.

name: Copernicus Data Space
description: Sentinel imagery and Copernicus land/atmosphere/marine products (open).

name: OpenTopography
description: High-resolution topography (DEM, LiDAR) and terrain derivatives.

name: ICIMOD Regional Data System
description: Mountain/hydromet data for the Hindu Kush Himalaya, including Indian Himalayan states.
